query: SELECT MS, Mk, Cn, Year, SUM(R) AS registrations, SUM(CAST(R AS float) * [M (kg)]) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN [M (kg)] IS NOT NULL THEN R END), 0) AS mass_kg, SUM(CAST(R AS float) * [Z (Wh/km)]) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN [Z (Wh/km)] IS NOT NULL THEN R END), 0) AS z_wh_km, SUM(CAST(R AS float) * Zr) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Zr IS NOT NULL THEN R END), 0) AS zr_km FROM [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars_2025Pv31] WHERE Ft = 'electric' AND MS IN ('NL', 'DE', 'FR', 'BE') GROUP BY MS, Mk, Cn, Year ORDER BY MS, Mk, Cn, Year
